tei:div.tei:p: ༁ྃཿ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i thugs tig bzhugs:

slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi dgongs pa'o// ༁ྃཿ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo: gzung 'dzin dregs pa'i gshin rje yi: gshed po sems nyid 'od gsal ba: rol pa 'gag med lha skur shar: de nyid sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor ni: aḥ rang bzhin gdod nas mnyam pa nyid: skye ba med pa'i ye shes las: skye ba'i gzugs brnyan yi ge a: snod bcud brtan g.yo kun gyi srog: cho 'phrul chen po'i rol pa yis: ma dag snang ba dbyings su nub: lhun grub ye shes gzhal med khang : rin chen dur khrod rgyan rdzogs dbus: klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong : phyogs skyong ma he nyi zla'i gdan: de steng stong nyid phyag rgya che: 'khor 'das zil gnon he ru ka: chos nyid mi 'gyur sku mdog mthing : rnam par thar pa gsum gyi dbu: g.yas dkar klu 'bum sbrul du 'dren: g.yon dmar gnyan khri'i snying nas gsol: dbus mthing dgra bgegs sa bdag za: rgyu drug 'khor ba sgrol ba'i phyag: ye shes drug gi phyag mtshan can: 'khor lo ral gri rdo rje g.yas: be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub g.yon: rdzu 'phrul zhabs bzhi dor stabs kyis: dug gsum dregs pa'i dpyi nas brdzis: glang chen ko rlon dur khrod chas: sbrul dang rin chen tsittas brgyan: dbu la rigs lnga khro bo'i sku: dregs pa'i snying dang nā ga'i mgo: do shal khro bo'i chas ka rdzogs: de bzhin nyid dbyings khros pa'i sku: yum ni dmigs med chos kyi dbyings: mthing nag snying stobs gri thod 'khyud: rgyan dang sprul pa'i lha rnams kun: nyi ma dang ni 'od zer bzhin: ma bskyed rang byung rol pa'i rtsal: 'khor 'das yongs rdzogs chen por gsal: sa ma ya: lha sku'i ting 'dzin brtan pa na: thugs kar 'jam dpal ye shes sems: dmar ser ral gri glegs bam phyag: de yi tsitta'i gur khang dbus: nyi steng hūm̐ gi nā da las: yi ge drug pa rdo rje'i sgra:

sngags kyi gzugs su snang ba las: 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byin rlabs bsdus: gsal zhing 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis: sgrib gnyis mun pa sel bar bsam: oṃ wā gī shwa ri mūm̐: zhi bar bsnyen pa 'bum phrag drug: bzlas te khro bor sgrub pa ni: hūm̐ mthar rdo rje'i sngags phreng las: sku dang sngags phreng phyag mtshan tshogs: 'bar ba'i 'od zer dang bcas 'phros: snang srid sbyangs te rang la bstim: e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya: lha sngags tha dad mi phyed pa: 'bum phrag bcu drug las kun byed: 'jam dpal khro bo'i nus pa rdzogs: sa ma ya: don gyi gshed po sgrub pa ni: sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba: thog ma bar dang mthar mi gnas: rgyu dang rkyen dang 'bras bu med: phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du bzhag: lus gnad byed bcings dbang po'i mchog: dbyings su gzir pas rtags rnams rdzogs: 'gro ba'i mar me ye shes sgron: don gyi 'jam dpal tshe 'dir 'grub: sa ma ya: dbang bskur byed na snod ldan pa'i: slob mas gsol ba 'di ltar gdab: chos dbyings bde bar dgyes rol pa'i: 'jam dpal khrag 'thung dgongs su gsol: he ru ka dpal grong khyer du: bdag cag 'jug cing smin par 'tshal: rgyud sbyangs lhar bskyed ye shes dbab: brtan par byas rjes bum dbang ni: oṃ: ye shes dag pa bum pa'i dbyings: phyag rgya zil gnon zhu ba'i bcud: rigs lnga 'dus pa'i bdud rtsi yis: ye shes lnga ru dbang bskur ro: sngags mthar: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī:āḥ kā lā sha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: sku dang rgyan chas phyag mtshan bstim: hūm̐: rang byung thig le nyag gcig las: 'khor 'das zil gnon lha skur shar: gnyis med phyag rgya'i dbang bskur bas: snang zhen gzung 'dzin rang grol shog: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hūm̐: dpal chen 'bar ba dbang gi chas: dur khrod chen po'i longs spyod kyis: dregs pa'i stobs dang srog 'phrog pa'i:

rje btsun mchog tu mnga' gsol lo: shrī he ru ka ā laṃ ka ra a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: hūm̐: srid pa'i drwa ba 'joms shing gcod: nyon mongs bdud 'dul bdud dgra gsod: gzung 'dzin tshar gcod gdug pa can: bsdigs shing zil gnon dbang bskur ro: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: bzlas pa'i lung sbyin sngags byang gtad: hūm̐: dpal chen gsang sngags rdo rje'i sgra: rtag tu chu bo'i gzhung bzhin zlos: rab 'byams phrin las 'grub pa dang : srog rtsol dag pa'i dbang thob shog: wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ dgongs pa ngo sprad don dbang bskur: hūm̐: e nyid stong pa chos 'byung las: ma skyes gnas pa dran par bya: rgyu rkyen sngags las ma bskyed par: dbyings rig zung 'jug rtogs par 'gyur: a a a tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rdo rje'i sdigs mdzub snying gar gtad: ye shes sems dpa' snying dbus bstim: dhīḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku: 'jam dpal ngag gi dbang phyug ni: rtag tu snying la yang dag gnas: byin rlabs mchog gis dbang bskur ro: oṃ wa gi shwa ri mūm̐: dzñā na sa twa a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: yon tan yongs rdzogs bam chen ni: lhar gsal slob ma'i gtsug tu bzhag: hoḥ dpa' brtul sngags kyis byin bskyed pa'i: bam chen rme ba'i don dang sbyor: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang thob nas: ye shes yon tan yongs rdzogs shog: ma hā māṃ sa gu ṇa siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hoḥ lha bstim dngos grub dam rdzas sbyin: phrin las mchod rten spyi bor bzhag: hūm̐: srung dang bshig dang bsad pa dang : klog dang mnan dang dkrugs pa sogs: rab 'byams phrin las dbang bsgyur ba'i: yongs rdzogs mchod rten dbang bskur ro: sarba karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi sbyin: āḥ sbyor ba dag pa'i byang chub sems: mtshan ldan phyag rgya'i padmor bskyil: dkar dmar lhag pa'i dam tshig rdzas: dpa' bo chen pos mnyam par rol:

bho dhi tsitta gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa hoḥ mtshan ldan gzungs ma byin brlabs sbyin: hūm̐: bkra shis padma'i mtshan ldan gsang ba'i yum: sangs rgyas kun gyi 'byung gnas che: 'dir zhugs 'dir ltos 'di don spyod: lhan cig skyes dga'i dbang thob shog: karma mu dra ma hā su kha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: me long 'ja' shel brdas mtshon te: dbyings rig 'jam dpal don ngo sprad: hoḥ ka nas dag pa'i dgongs pa las: lhun grub ye shes snang ba shar: zung 'jug zil gnon phyag rgya che: rang byung don gyi dbang thob shog: dzñā na dhā tu a bhi ṣiñtsa a a a: dregs pa'i dmar gtor lag tu gtad: ya bhyo: chags sdang dbang gis dregs pa ni: ma mo gshin rje'i tshogs yin te: dbang sdud bran du bkol nas kyang : phrin las rab 'byams sgrub par gyis: ya bhyoḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bkra shis tshe gal mthun bsdebs sbyin: bhrūm̐ḥ snying po'i srog dang byang chub sems: mi 'gyur thig le gcig tu 'khyil: rdo rje tshe yi dbang bskur bas: 'chi med rtag pa'i dbang thob shog: ā yurdzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa bhrūm̐: bkra shis brjod cing me tog 'thor: dam tshig khas blang gtang rag dbul: phyag rgya zil gnon yongs rdzogs kyi: smin byed dbang gi snying po'o: sa ma ya: srung dang bzlog pa'i phrin las ni: rgya shog gtsang mar rgya snag gis: 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mu khyud bcas: lte bar e mthar spel tshig dang : rtsibs brgyad rtsa ba'i gsang sngags bkod: mu khyud dbyangs gsal 'dod gsol dang : rten snying rdo ra me ris bskor: gi bam̐ shu dag gu gul byug: rab tu gnas shing lus la 'chang : pu ri dkar po'i klong sgrom du: phyag rgya zil gnon lha skur bsgom: phyi rol 'khor lo drug gis gtams: mi phyed rdo rje'i rang bzhin bsam: badzra kā wā tsidzñā na tsa kra rakṣa rakṣa bhrūm̐: bzlas shing lta ba'i gding bskyed la: srid gsum 'khrugs kyang ya mi nga :

phyir zlog 'khor lo 'chang ba'am: dmar gtor dgra bgegs 'gug cing bstim: thod rnga brdung zhing phrin las bcol: hūm̐ bhyo: bde gshegs mthu stobs 'dus pa'i dpal: 'khor 'das zil gnon he ru ka: yab yum sprul pa yang 'khor bcas: dbyings las ye shes sku ru bzhengs: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma bzhes: mngon spyod dmod pa'i dus la bab: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: dug gsum rgyu 'bras las byung ba'i: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog: ma rig rnam rtog las byung ba'i: gdon bgegs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog: kun brtags 'khrul pa las byung ba'i: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog: gzhan dbang 'pho 'gyur las byung ba'i: dus min 'chi ba bco brgyad zlog: phyi nang bden zhen las byung ba'i: 'byung bzhi phyi yi g.yo 'khrug zlog: rtsa rlung thig le las byung ba'i: rnal 'byor nang gi bar chad zlog: nga bdag 'gong po las byung ba'i: gzung 'dzin gsang ba'i sun ma zlog: 'dod chags sred zhen las byung ba'i: snod bcud dbul zhing phongs pa zlog: zhe sdang gdug sems las byung ba'i: byad phur rbod gtong mtshan 'khrugs zlog: gti mug rmongs pa las byung ba'i: dam sri kla klo'i 'tshe ba zlog: nga rgyal khengs sems las byung ba'i: dregs pa sde brgyad cho 'phrul zlog: phrag dog gdug rtsub las byung ba'i: 'jigs chen brgyad dang bcu drug zlog: zlog go mi mthun rnam rtog tshogs: gzhi dbyings ka dag klong du zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan sems byung kun: gzhi snang lhun grub chen por sgyur: thams cad 'od gsal gnyug ma'i dbyings: 'khrul pa dag pa'i phrin las mdzod: sarba sa ma ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces brjod thal mo dul mo brdab: gtor ma gnod pa'i phyogs su 'phang : 'gal rkyen sprin ltar gtibs pa yang : skad cig nyid la bzlog par 'gyur: sa ma ya: sdig sgrib bar chad zhi 'dod na: rin chen sna tshogs phye ma la:

pu ri dkar po mtshan rdzogs bzhengs: nang du 'jam dpal zhi khro'i sngags: a nṛ su tri pre du sarba pā paṃ kle sha duḥkha shīntaṃ ku ru swā hā: sarba bighnān sha trūn a pa ka ra shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā: zhes gdags bris pa bdud rtsis byug: bzang po'i shing la dril te gzhug: de nyid dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhag: 'jam dpal zhi khro'i sku ru bskyed: thugs ka'i hūm̐ las e chad de: de las 'bar ba'i me 'od dkar: mkha' khyab spros te rang gzhan gyi: sna bug nas zhugs lus kun gang : rigs drug bag chags sdig sgrib dang : gdon bgegs bar chad kun bsregs nas: byin rlabs gzi byin ldan par bsgom: khrus byas mi gtsang lus las don: nam mkhar 'phur sogs rmi lam ltas: byung na zhi ba'i mtshan mar shes: de thob las kun 'grub par bshad: sa ma ya: tshe dang bsod nams rgyas 'dod na: snying po lnga dang rin chen lnga: a mṛ ta yis sbrus byas la: 'brang rgyas sngags kyi srog ldan bzhengs: dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhag nas kyang : bdag mdun lhar gsal thugs srog las: nyi ma 'char ka'i mdangs 'od 'phros: sprul pa'i pho nya stong gsum gang : ri rab 'gul zhing rgya mtsho 'khyom: dregs pa dbang sdud zil gyis mnan: bla tshe brkus nyams yar ba bkug: srid zhi'i dwangs bcud mer mer bsdus: snying po thugs kyi thig ler thim: 'chi med rdo rje'i srog 'grub bsam: mi 'gyur rtsa ba'i snying po'i sham: ā yurdzñā na puṇye siddhi puṣtiṃ ku ru oṃ: zhes bzlas skabs su pho nya btang : eḥ nga ni rang byung ye shes dbyings: phyag rgya ma btsal lhun gyis grub: che ba kun gyi rgyal po ste: 'khor 'das thams cad zil gyis gnon: 'jam dpal khrag 'thung stobs po che'i: rdo rje'i bka' nan mkha' dang mnyam: sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang : yi dam zhi khro mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: 'jig rten dregs pa thams cad kun: nga yi dbyings las g.yos pa med:

sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i khams: dwangs ma lnga 'dus bdag la rdzogs: rol pa chen po'i cho 'phrul gyi: 'khor 'das thams cad las la bzhengs: 'byung pos brkus pa'i bla tshe 'phrog: rang bzhin yar ba thams cad sdus: tshe yi rdzing bu nyams pa gsos: bsod nams nyi zla 'grib pa skyed: ye shes rig rtsal gong du spor: mi 'gyur mi shigs rtag pa'i tshe: 'grib med bsod nams g.yung drung 'khyil: snying ga dpal gyi be'u'i dbyings: dbyer med rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: zhes dang sngags brjod ting 'dzin spor: shin tu zab pa'i tshe sgrub ste: bsod nams dpal kun bskyed pa'o: sa ma ya: rgyal blon rig ma khye'u dang : nor dang 'bru dang zas gos sogs: dbang sdud phrin las brtsam pa ni: rin chen thod pa mtshan ldan nang : ratna 'bru sman spos phyes gtams: dmar po'i gzhi la byang sems gnyis: mnyam par byas te 'phrul 'khor bri: padma'i lte bar e dmar po'i: tha mar snying po sngags 'di sbyar: che ge mo dam dam: ta ra ta ra: ba sha naṃ: ba sha naṃ: sdus sdus: bā shaṃ ku ru ho: 'dab ma la'ang de bzhin te: mu khyud dbyangs gsal rten snying dang : ratna ka pā la bā shaṃ siddhi ku ru hoḥ de ni zil gnon khro bo bskyed: rjes chags rol pa'i 'od zer ni: rab dmar nyi ma 'char kha'i mdangs: snod bcud kun la khyab cing zhugs: khyad par dmigs pa'i yul kun dkrigs: rang dbang med par bskul byas te: dregs pa'i tshogs kyis dbang med bkug: brtan pa bral te 'dud par bsam: gong gi sngags bzlas ting 'dzin gsal: las mtha' dbang gi sreg blugs bya: dbang sdud las kyi sbyor ba'o: sa ma ya: bsgral zhing bcu dang nyams pa bdun: bsad dang bsreg dang mnan pa ste: dur khrod 'jigs pa'i sa gzhi la: phung po ro sol brub khung bya: gri khrag byugs shing rtsang gis bskor: dur khrod ras sam dug shog la: dme khrag tsha ba dug snas byugs: de dang rdo sol snag tsha yis:

bsad pa'i 'khor lo rgya gram dbus: gru gsum phyi rol mtshon 'khor bskor: e la mi 'gyur rtsa ba'i sngags: rwa mtshams e ya bhyo yig phreng : 'khor lor las sngags spu gri ni: dmod pa'i tshig dang ldan par bya: srid pa ru sbal lto bar gtams: thod ngan nang gzhug de yi 'og: zag rdzas dug khrag tsha ba las: liṅga bri'am 'bur du gtod: byad thag dkri zhing thun rdzas gsar: rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin du bskul: dmigs bya dgug bstim sngags 'di bzla: che ge mo gṛhṇa gṛhṇa bhandha bhandha: ā karṣa ya: ā karṣa ya: nā sha ya: nā sha ya: ha ra ha ra: mo ha ya mo ha ya: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho: khug pa'i rtags byung thun gyis gzir: eḥ khro rgyal 'dus pa yungs kar thog: ma mo khrag gi rba rlabs 'khrugs: klu bdud dug gi kha chu 'bebs: thibs gnon gdug pa rdo rje'i mtshe: gza' rgod mig dmar gzer mda' 'phen: gshin rje srog gcod zangs lcags char: mtshon cha sna tshogs rdo yi thun: 'bebs pa zil gnon sprul pas 'bebs: 'ben ni dgra dang bgegs la bcas: nyams pa'i lus sems rdul du rlog: rtsa ba'i sngags dang mtshon chas gzir: e myags ya rngubs mug sha ka ka dun: dgra bo'i srog la breng hur thum dza rtsa khrag snying thum ril raṃ shag rbad: srog thum ril dza rtsa khrag hur raṃ: snying thun rbad srog la mā ra ya bhyo: nyams pa kha sbyor bye ba'i rtags: byung ba ral gris rū pa gtubs: e: 'jam dpal khros pa zil gnon mtshon: shes rab ral gri rnon po yis: dgra bgegs gzugs brnyan dum bur gtubs: tshe dang bsod nams rang la 'dus: rnam shes dmigs med chos dbyings thim: sha khrag khro bo rngams pa'i tshogs: dgyes pa chen po'i zhal du bstabs: mngon spyod phrin las mthar phyin mdzod: e hur thum khaḍga tīkṣ+ṇa hri dir mā ra ya kha kha khā hi khā hi: drag po'i zhal bstab zlog phrin gsol: cha gcig mdze thod nang du bcug: klu bdud gdug pa'i gre bar gtad:

cha gcig dug shing me sbar la: rngams khros 'khyil pa bskyed cing bsreg: thal ba rgya gram lam 'og mnan: rdo rje'i bro brdung phyir mi ldog: srid gsum dgra bgegs brlag pa'i thabs: 'bum phrag kun gyi snying po'o: sa ma ya: mchog gi ye shes lam byed pa: 'jam dpal don gyi snying po ni: nges 'byung drag pos rang rgyud sbyangs: skyabs sems bla ma'i byin rlabs dbab: snod du gyur nas rnal 'byor ni: 'khor lo rnam pa bzhi yin te: rang bzhin 'od gsal byang chub sems: stong nyid 'jam pa gsal ba'i dpal: zung 'jug ye shes sem dpa' ni: gnas pa'i 'khor lo gzhi yi rgyud: 'gro ba kun la khyab par bzhugs: de nyid ma rtogs gzung 'dzin gyi: srid pa'i 'khor lo sna tshogs pa: rtsa dang rlung dang byang chub sems: kun gzhi ye shes cir yang snang : 'dul thabs sprul pa'i 'khor lo ni: snang ba sbyong byed dbyibs kyi lam: zil gnon khrag 'thung phyag rgyar bsgom: stong nyid ma skyes rang bzhin la: e yig lhun grub gzugs skur bzhengs: rnam thar dbu la phar phyin phyag: tshad med zhabs ldan 'byung ba lnga: 'dus pa'i ye shes chen po yis: 'khor 'das thams cad khyab cing gnon: gzhi lam 'bras gsum rang la rdzogs: dag pa dran pa gnad kyi gzer: yul gsum gsal bar gyur pa dang : zhen pa sbyong byed sngags kyi thabs: rlung lam rdo rje'i bzlas pas sbyang : kha sbyor bum pa srog rtsol btsud: de las gtum mo'i me sbar bas: ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi: gshin rjes rtsa 'khor thams cad khyab: bde ba gsol ba'i bdud rtsi yis: gsol btab ka dag ngang du bzhag: snang zhen las su rung ba na: bu mo utpal mig yangs la: brtag cing btsal la gsang rtsa sprad: kā kā mu kha'i reg bya yis: nyon mongs 'ching ba gcod par bya: de tshe bde ba'i ngo bo nyid: thig le gcig tu 'dus par blta: bsam gyis mi khyab dgongs pa'i gding : mi g.yo mnyam pa nyid du bzhag:

'khor ba rnam par rtog pa ste: myang 'das ngo bo stong pa nyid: phyag rgya chen po ma bcos pa: de yis gzung 'dzin zil gyis gnon: 'jam dpal zhes ni de la bya: gsang ba'i lam nas ye shes gdangs: nam mkhar shar ba bzhin du byas: dbyings rig thig ler 'dzud pa yis: snang ba mched cing gong du 'phel: thams cad 'jam dpal sku ru shar: khams gsum thams cad de yis gang : srid gsum g.yo ba sdud cing zad: slar yang ye shes rang snang bas: 'pho ba'i bag chags rgyu dang bcas: yongs su gcod cing sems can don: lhun grub rgyun mi chad pa'i phyir: 'khor lo mi zad rgyan du rdzogs: mthar thug 'bras bu chen po'o: sa ma ya: las kyi sbyor sde sna tshogs ni: bum pa chu sna dgu yis dgang : bdag nyid zil gnon thugs ka nas: 'od 'phros bum pa'i dngos 'dzin sbyangs: snod ni gzhal yas byang sems bcud: snying po 'jam dpal lha sngags gsal: ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis bkang : sngags bzlas 'od zhu 'thor 'thung dang : nye reg byas pas nad gdon dang : khyad par klu yi dug kun zhi: las mthun shing la me sbar te: lha bskyed bdud rtsi'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: yang na sha khrag rus par dmigs: zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun byed: yul khams phung ba'i dam sri'i sde: rang rang srog gi thod par grub: stobs chen yongs rdzogs mchod rten 'og: mnan cing gzir bas phyis mi ldang : 'jam dpal grub pa'i rtsa mchog las: rdo rje tshe yi sngags kyis btab: ra mo shag gi khu bas dbul: tshe dang lus kyi bcud len 'grub: sa ma ya: dang po rang byung sngags kyi rgyud: zla gsang bye ba 'bum phrag las: snying po'i snying po mdo tsam zhig: 'jam dpal bzang pos gnad bsdus te: brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dbang por gtad: bdag nyid blo ldan mchog sred kyis: 'ga' zhig sa yi bcud du gtams: la la klong lnga'i sgrom bur bstsal: snyan brgyud 'di ni skal ldan la: dgongs pa byin rlabs tshul du bshad:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu hya: ma 'ongs 'di spyod las can ni: gnubs kyi dge slong rigs sngags 'chang : bod khams mtha' dang dbus su 'byung : the tshom med par nyams blangs na: bdun gsum mi mthun keka las grol: dam sri rkun po'i bar chad zhi: brgyud 'dzin 'phel zhing bkra shis thob: gzhan yang grags pa mchog dang dbyangs: mthu chen bstan pa spel la dga': de dang de la sogs pa yi: las can mang zhig tshul 'di la: brten nas nus pa'i gding thob ste: bstan pa srung zhing rang rgyud grol: gdul bya yongs su smin par 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu hya: badzra mant+ra garbha a ti gu hya sa ma ya:

zhes pa'ang slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis byin gyis brlabs shing*/ lhun grub rig 'dzin blo ldan mchog sred kyis rjes su gdams pa'i snyan brgyud 'di ni/ gnubs kyi skye rgyud zung sogs skal ba dang ldan pa dag la phan pa'i yid kyis mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang dgyes pa'i 'bangs padma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pas skad cig gis gtan la phab pa'o// //
